subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: After the lint blocker is fixed, should this PR land as the targeted bootstrap-context event-loop mitigation despite changing bootstrap glob traversal and bootstrap hook scheduling for existing sessions?
rationale: The code path addresses a real P1 stall, but it changes how existing bootstrap-extra-files globs and bootstrap hook chains execute, which is a session-context compatibility choice automation should not silently accept.

options.title: Accept After Lint Fix
options.body: Fix the two Promise executor lint errors, require exact-head green checks, and let an agents/bootstrap owner accept the remaining compatibility and session-context risk before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Runtime Delta
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep only the async workspace/glob stall fix and defer hook scheduling or diagnostic timing if maintainers want less session-context change in this PR.

options.title: Pause For Broader Architecture
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers prefer to solve the broader event-loop architecture under the larger tracker instead of landing this targeted mitigation.

recommendation.title: Accept After Lint Fix
recommendation.body: Fix the two Promise executor lint errors, require exact-head green checks, and let an agents/bootstrap owner accept the remaining compatibility and session-context risk before merge.
